## Completeness, checked against the official sources (2026-11-12)

| Constitution | Main codes | National law | Law-making regions | Case law |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| held | 80% | 0.4% (estimate, high confidence, 0.4–0.9%) | not applicable | 0% |

iceland-law holds 7 distinct acts, not a statute book: the Icelandic Lagasafn texts of the Constitution, Almenn hegningarlög, the two procedure acts, Samningalög and the trade-union act, with per-article history from 1995, plus 4 old English translations. Stjórnsýslulög 37/1993 is missing, there is no case law, and althingi.is blocked automated access (Cloudflare challenge), so no provision could be checked against the official text.

Shares are of what exists, not of what each repository says it holds; estimates are marked, with their method in [data/completeness.json](../data/completeness.json).
